title: 金融男转身，和技术合伙人一起做到4.5万MRR
title_en: Finance Guy Pivots, Hits $45K MRR with Tech Co-founder
title_jp: 金融マンが転身、技術パートナーと月間45KドルのMRRを達成
title_ar: رجل المال يغير مساره ويحقق 45 ألف دولار MRR مع شريك تقني
carouselChartTitle: 金融男转身，和技术合伙人一起做到4.5万MRR
author: 阿星
content:
{"ops": [{"insert": "金融男转身，和技术合伙人一起做到4.5万MRR"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/119Zbnde7pTET0QOiZLH/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/iron-brands-founder-of-simple-analytics.png"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 作者: Iron Brands", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 标签: 自举创业、内容营销、SaaS、SEO", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有穿过西装打领带，坐在写字楼里，却感觉窒息的时刻？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Iron有过。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而且只撑了几周。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大学毕业后，Iron信心满满地进入金融行业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "西装革履，人模狗样。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后呢？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""几周后我就发现，这不是我要的生活。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "太窒息了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和大学同学搞了个项目。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "叫Fiks，实习市场平台。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做到10万美元年收入，Iron决定退出。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "老合伙人还在运营，做得不错。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但Iron知道：我喜欢的是建造，不是坐办公室。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他搬到阿姆斯特丹。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "到处参加创业者聚会，认识 builder。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在一个开发者 meetup 上，他遇到了Adriaan。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Adriaan几年前单枪匹马做了个产品，叫Simple Analytics。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "两个人一聊，决定合伙。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "今天？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Simple Analytics做到4.5万MRR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们的开源指标页面上，数据清清楚楚。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "防谷歌分析——这个概念本身就很有态度。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在隐私焦虑越来越重的今天，Simple Analytics主打一个简单而坚定：没有cookie，没有跟踪，没有弹出窗口。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "数据归用户所有，就这么简单。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但这篇文章最精彩的部分不是产品本身。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是Iron的角色。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说得很直接：我认为我的作用是解锁合伙人的潜力。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Simple Analytics在他加入之前已经是1万MRR，但要继续增长，产品在成熟，分发也要跟得上。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这才是Iron大展拳脚的地方。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还和Dries一起把UniHosted从一个半成品变成了真正的生意。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最近又收购了Leadsontrees.com。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这项目有客户，但卖的是终身授权。我们改成订阅制，现在250 MRR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈？Iron说他说不出啥聪明的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "我知道我们用Vue和Node，就这些。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他的营销栈很清晰："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用Simple Analytics做数据分析（吃自家饭）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Semrush搞SEO", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Seogets看自然流量（Google Search Console 的加强版）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Substack发newsletter", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Mailgun发邮件", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Nano Banana做视觉", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Firecrawl喂LLM", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Loom录视频", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "获客策略分两步："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一步：手 hustle。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "去Reddit、Twitter、LinkedIn、Facebook群组。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和人聊天，帮人解决问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "目标就一个：让人试试你的产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "获得第一批客户超级重要，你要用尽书中所有花招。做那些不能规模化的事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第二步：找规模化渠道。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不能天天手动拉用户。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "要找一个可持续、可重复的增长渠道。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "对Simple Analytics来说，就是SEO："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "回答垂直领域的问题", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写Alternative to页面（我们是Google Analytics的替代品）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "搞外链", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做程序化SEO", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "专注质量", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Iron写了两篇文章详细讲：《如何获得前100个用户》《如何获得前1000个用户》"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "定价策略也很聪明：反向免费试用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用户注册后，14天内可以用完整版，不管选什么套餐。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "14天后必须做选择。根据他们的使用情况，系统会推荐一个套餐，但他们可以选任何一档。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你必须选一个套餐才能继续使用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这种紧迫感，比传统的先免费再想怎么收钱有效得多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "什么建议Iron最想给新手创始人？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "越早开始越好。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有人说你需要更多经验才能创业，我不同意。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的很多朋友现在被手铐拷住了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "好工作、配车、刚买房、想生孩子。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "让他们再回到一穷二白、还可能失败的状态？不可能了。代价太大。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而Iron开始的时候，是个穷学生，继续穷几年也没差。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有时候我会嫉妒朋友在德勤拿高薪，但现在回头看，我庆幸自己选了这条路。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有：别怕犯错。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你不可能一开始就很厉害，你会犯很蠢的错误。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的第一家公司，因为不懂技术，做市场而不是SaaS。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也没验证，就拍脑袋觉得能行。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果能重来，我会完全改变第一个公司的设置。但我学到了很多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "只要回头看一年前的自己，觉得那时候我真傻，你就走对路了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最后，他说了一句特别暖的话："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "首先，你能走上独立创业这条路，你就是传奇。大多数想创业的人，根本不会开始。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "其次，第一次可能会失败，没关系。我的第一家创业公司很难，但我学到了太多。如果那时候放弃，我现在就不会在这里。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以，别放弃。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "留在牌桌上。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Simple Analytics的下一步？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Iron说他产品无感，Simple Analytics更像是Adriaan的孩子。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "我就是喜欢帮技术型创始人成功，这是我的激情所在。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的目标是：帮更多技术创始人把想法变成盈利的生意。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文链接:", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " https://www.indiehackers.com/post/119Zbnde7pTET0QOiZLH"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "本内容基于 Indie Hackers 文章二次创作，采用 咪蒙式叙事风格重写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "**"}]}
content_en:
{"ops": [{"insert": "Finance Guy Pivots, Hits $45K MRR with Tech Co-founder"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Have you ever worn a suit and tie, sat in an office building, but felt suffocated? Iron has. And he only lasted a few weeks."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "After graduating from college, Iron confidently entered the finance industry. Dressed in suit and tie, looking sharp. Then what? A few weeks later, I realized this is not the life I want. Too suffocating."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He started a project with a college classmate. Called Fiks, an internship marketplace platform. Reached $100,000 annual revenue, Iron decided to exit. The old partner is still running it, doing well. But Iron knows: I like building, not sitting in an office."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He moved to Amsterdam. Went to entrepreneur meetups everywhere, meeting builders. At a developer meetup, he met Adriaan. Adriaan built a product solo a few years ago, called Simple Analytics. They talked, decided to partner. Today? Simple Analytics hit $45K MRR."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "On their open-source metrics page, the data is crystal clear. Google Analytics alternative-this concept itself has attitude. In today world of growing privacy anxiety, Simple Analytics stands firm: no cookies, no tracking, no pop-ups. Data belongs to users. Simple as that."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But the best part of this article is not the product itself. It is Iron role. He said it directly: I think my role is to unlock the co-founder potential. Simple Analytics was already at $10K MRR before he joined, but to keep growing, the product was maturing, and distribution needed to keep up. That is where Iron really shine."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He also helped Dries turn UniHosted from a half-finished product into a real business. Recently acquired Leadsontrees.com. The project had customers but sold lifetime licenses. They switched to subscription, now $250 MRR."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tech stack? Iron says he cannot say anything smart. I know we use Vue and Node, that is it. But his marketing stack is clear: Use Simple Analytics for data analysis, Semrush for SEO, Seogets for organic traffic, Substack for newsletter, Mailgun for emails, Nano Banana for visuals, Firecrawl for LLM, Loom for videos."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Customer acquisition strategy has two steps: Step one: Manual hustle. Go to Reddit, Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook groups. Talk to people, help them solve problems. Goal is one: get people to try your product. Getting the first customers is super important. Step two: Find scalable channels. Find a sustainable, repeatable growth channel. For Simple Analytics, that is SEO: Answer niche-specific questions, Write Alternative to pages, Build backlinks, Do programmatic SEO, Focus on quality."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Pricing strategy is also smart: reverse free trial. After registration, users can use the full version for 14 days. After 14 days, they must choose. This urgency is much more effective than the traditional approach."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What advice does Iron most want to give new founders? Start as early as possible. Some say you need more experience to start a business-I disagree. Many of his friends are now handcuffed. Good job, company car, just bought a house, want to have kids. Ask them to go back to being broke? Impossible. When Iron started, he was a poor student-being poor for a few more years did not matter."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Also: Do not be afraid of making mistakes. You cannot be great from the start-you will make stupid mistakes. His first company, because he did not understand tech, did marketing instead of SaaS. If I could do it over, I would completely change the first company setup. But I learned a lot."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Finally: First, if you can walk the path of independent entrepreneurship, you are legendary. Most people who want to start a business never even begin. Second, first time might fail-that is okay. My first startup was tough, but I learned so much. If I had given up back then, I would not be here now. So, do not give up. Stay at the table."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What is next for Simple Analytics? Iron says he is product-agnostic-Simple Analytics is more like Adriaan child. I just like helping technical founders succeed-that is my passion. His goal is: help more technical founders turn ideas into profitable businesses."}, {"insert": "
"}]}
content_jp:
{"ops": [{"insert": "金融マンが転身、技術パートナーと月間45KドルのMRRを達成"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "スーツを着てネクタイを締め、オ피스ビルに座って息的詰まったことはあるか？アイロンにはあった。そして数週間しか持たなかった。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大学卒業後 アイロンは自信满满に金融業界に入った。スーツ姿で髦的生产。然は何？数週間後に気づいた、これはじゃない生活だと。息的詰まりすぎた。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "彼は大學の同級生とプロジェクトをやった。フィクスという、インターン市場プラットフォーム。年收入10万ドルを達成しアイロンは退出を決定。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "旧パートナーはまだ運営しており、悪くない。でもアイロンは分かる：好きだったのはビルディング而非办公室。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "彼はアムステルダムに移住。起業家の聚会にいっぱい行ってbuilderを増やす。开发者のmeetupで、彼はアドリアーンに会った。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "アドリアーンは数年前 一人でSimple Analyticsという製品を 만든。二人は話し合って、パートナーになることに。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "今現在は？Simple Analyticsは45K MRRを達成。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "彼らのオープンソースメトリクスページには、データが清清楚楚Google Analytics alternative。このコンセプト自体に态度がある。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "プライバシー不安が越来越多的今 Simple Analyticsはシンプルに坚定Cookieなし、トラッキングなし、ポップアップなし。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "でもこの記事的最佳部分不是产品本身。是Iron的角色。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "彼は言った：私の役割は合伙人の潜力を发挥させることだ。Simple Analyticsは参加前にすでに10K MRRだったが、成長を続けるには、製品の成熟と流通の跟上が必要。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "彼もまたDriesと協力してUniHostedを半成品から本格的なビジネスに変えた。最近Leedsontrees.comを取得。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技術スタック？アイロンは说不出啥聪明的。でも彼のマーケティングスタックは明確。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "顧客獲得戦略は2ステップ第一步手作业。第二步スケール可能なチャネルを見つける。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "価格設定も賢い逆フリートライアル。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "アイロンが最も新人创始者に伝えたいアドバイス？できるだけ早く始めろ。そして：错误を恐れない。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最後に：独立起業之路を歩むことができるなら你是传奇。第二次可能失败没关系别放弃。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Simple Analyticsの下一步？アイロンは说自己对产品无感，就是喜欢帮技术创始人成功。"}, {"insert": "
"}]}
content_ar:
{"ops": [{"insert": "رجل المال يغير مساره ويحقق 45 ألف دولار MRR مع شريك تقني"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "هل سبق أن ارتديت بدلة وربطة عنق، وجلست في مكتب، لكن شعرت بالاختناق؟ إلين كان كذلك. واستمر فقط أسابيع قليلة."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "بعد التخرج من الجامعة، دخل إلين بثقة في صناعة المال. ثم ماذا؟ أدركت أن هذا ليس life الذي أريد. م suffocating جداً."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "بدأ مشروعاً مع زميل في الكلية. يُسمى Fiks، منصة سوق التدريب. وصل لإيرادات سنوية 100 ألف دولار، إلين قرر الخروج."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "انتقل إلى أمستردام. ذهب إلى لقاءات رواد الأعمال. في لقاء للمطورين، قابل أدريان. أدريان أنتج منتجاً منفرداً، يُسمى Simple Analytics. تحدثا وقررا الشراكة. اليوم؟ Simple Analytics بلغت 45K MRR."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "في صفحة المقاييس مفتوحة المصدر، البيانات واضحة. بديل Google Analyticsهذا المفهوم له موقفه."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "لكن أفضل جزء هو دور إلين. قالها مباشرة: أعتقد أن دوري هو فتح潜力الشريك."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "أيضاً ساعد دريس في تحويل UniHosted إلى عمل حقيقي. recently استحوذ على Leadsontrees.com."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "مكدس التقنية؟ لا يستطيع قول شيء ذكي. لكن مكدس التسويق واضح."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "استراتيجية اكتساب العملاء لها خطوتان: الجهد اليدوي، ثم قنوات قابلة للتوسع."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "نصيحة إلين؟ ابدأ في أقرب وقت ممكن. ولا تخف من ارتكاب الأخطاء."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "أخيراً: إذا كان يمكنك السير في مسار الريادة المستقلة، أنت أسطورة. لا تستسلم."}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "ما التالي؟ يريد مساعدة المزيد من المؤسسين التقنيين."}, {"insert": "
"}]}
